title: Matched neighbourhood controls and annotation diagnostics for attributing the gains of spatial encoders: software and results archive
description:
Software and results archive for a study of what learned spatial encoders add beyond averaging over their own graphs: label diagnostics of every reference annotation, a construction-scale experiment on rebuilt lung niches, a prospective test in three cohorts analysed under a protocol deposited before their expression data were downloaded (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24303149), and the attribution protocol applied to Tessera-ST, GraphST and STAGATE against parameter-free propagation on their own graphs.

This version holds the analysis code, the derived inputs of the prospective cohorts with their download receipts, every result table (fit records, scores, selections, counterparts, summaries) and the protocol with its list of departures. Saved embeddings are not included; they are regenerated by the code. The files of the earlier versions are kept unchanged in this record: the complete source and saved results of the calibration analyses of Tessera-ST, with the manuscript and supplement that reported them, and the code and result tables of the budget, tuning and cluster-number analyses.

Author-owned software is MIT licensed; author-generated research text, figures and results are CC BY 4.0. Third-party data and annotations retain their original terms.
notes: The code of this version is the folder revision-r3/ of https://github.com/PeterPonyu/tessera-st (tag 2026.11.17-revision-r3). Its analysis protocol was deposited at doi:10.5281/zenodo.24303149 before the prospective cohorts' expression data were downloaded; the protocol records two earlier contacts with those data. The encoder fits ran with Python 3.11.10 and PyTorch 2.5.1 with CUDA 12.4 (revision-r3/W4/BOX.md in tessera-revision-r3-results.zip, and every fit record); the other analyses ran with Python 3.13.
